description.text: The 30th Celebration Deluxe Deck Sets (30周年庆典 豪华卡组套装) came out on 16 September 2026 with the 30th Celebration booster, in two versions, Espeon and Umbreon. Each held a ready-to-play Pokémon ex deck with a card explaining how it plays and a beginner's guide, a metal deck box with a damage-counter case, a paper playmat, a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and two 30th Celebration packs. Espeon ex's attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon its player has in play, so that deck fills the field; Umbreon ex's attack does 240 damage when the opponent's Active Pokémon already has damage counters, so that deck attacks early and lets Umbreon ex finish the job. This set holds the cards of both decks, numbered out of 40; the basic Energy print their type code instead of a number.
